adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that Office365CalendarService.createEvent (line 73) uses `const [mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? [];` to always select the first destination calendar, regardless of which credential is being used. Unlike GoogleCalendarService which was updated to accept a credentialId parameter and find the matching destination calendar (`calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`), Office365, Lark, and the base CalendarService were not updated with this logic. When EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents iterates through multiple destination calendars for collective events and calls createEvent with different credentials, these services will always use the first host's destination calendar instead of the calendar matching the current credential. This is a real bug where secondary hosts in collective bookings will have events created in the wrong calendar.
